subject: prd/feature-implementation-drive
statement: Hosted human merge authority and required review/check/current-base enforcement remain unchanged; explicit local-git task and final landings use only the operator procedure in FR-31/FR-32 with the accepted unauthenticated shared-account limit.
rationale: The drive gains no approval or landing operation; the local route must not claim guarantees its origin cannot enforce.
fit_criterion: Hosted authorization and ruleset fixtures retain prior outcomes. Local fixtures prove generation/evidence/ref consistency and zero drive-invoked landings, while status and landing output state that the operator and agent share an OS account that can directly edit hooks and refs. No independent approval signing key, copied-origin identity, or host-level mainline protection is required. Existing signed execution ownership, task claims, e2e runner authentication, and manual-human candidate attestations retain their contracts; a local receipt cannot stand in for them. No implicit local fallback or re-enabling of Pyxis source's disabled legacy document checks occurs.
